meta.name: apple-health
meta.description: Connect agents to Apple Health exports with MCP setup, schema validation, and privacy-safe analysis.

copy.tagline: 将苹果健康数据接入智能助手
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望通过 MCP 让 AI 助手访问你的苹果健康数据
copy.tagline_en: Connect Apple Health data to your AI assistant
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI access to your Apple Health data via MCP

howto.what: Claude 可以读取你导出的 Apple Health 数据（CSV 文件），进行趋势分析、总结或 SQL 查询，所有分析都在本地进行，不会泄露健康记录。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 Apple Health 数据（如步数、睡眠、心率趋势）时触发。首次使用需要先确认导出模式（CSV 导出或仅规划）。

say.text: 帮我分析最近一周的步数变化趋势
say.note: Claude 会读取步数数据并给出趋势总结。

say.text: 查一下我上个月的睡眠数据，看看平均时长
say.note: Claude 会查询睡眠类别数据并返回统计结果。

howto.what_en: Claude can read your exported Apple Health CSV data to perform trend analysis, summaries, or SQL queries, all processed locally without exposing health records.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze Apple Health data (e.g., steps, sleep, heart rate trends). First use requires confirming export mode (CSV export or planning only).

say_en.text: Analyze my step count trend for the last week.
say_en.note: Claude will read step data and give a trend summary.

say_en.text: Check my sleep data from last month and show average duration.
say_en.note: Claude will query sleep category data and return statistics.
